summary.text: An infant son of Thyestes and one of the tragic victims of the Atreid curse, slaughtered and served to his father at a banquet.

story.text: Orchomenus, along with his brothers Aglaus and Callileon, was murdered by his uncle Atreus. Atreus cooked their flesh and fed it to Thyestes, only revealing the horrific truth after Thyestes had eaten his fill.
